metadata.description: Funding opportunities for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML students pursuing MSc/PhD abroad (2027-2029)
metadata.targetProfile: Bangladeshi student, CS/AI/ML/Data Science, seeking fully-funded or partially-funded graduate programs
metadata.criticalNote: PhD programs typically offer full funding; MSc funding highly competitive and varies by country. Apply to multiple funding sources simultaneously.

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Good for PhD, competitive for MSc

governmentScholarships.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Very low, 5-10 awarded globally per year to developing countries

universityFunding.availability: High for PhD, medium for MSc
topFundedUniversities: University of Toronto - Vector Institute affiliates
universityFunding.fundingNote: Most PhD positions in AI/ML are funded if accepted by supervisor with active grants; MSc often requires self-funding or competitive scholarships

fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: 20 hours/week during term, full-time during breaks
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply for fully-funded PhD positions with AI labs; for MSc, target smaller universities with better funding ratios or plan partial self-funding with part-time work

universityFunding.availability: Good for PhD (employment model)
universityFunding.fundingNote: Austrian PhD contracts are employment-based (similar to Germany) — you are an employee with full social security, pension, and healthcare. This is a major advantage over self-funded models.

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Adequate — EUR 2,200/month covers Vienna living costs comfortably
fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: Allowed up to 20 hrs/week for non-EU students; full work rights as PhD employee
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply for TU Wien or TU Graz PhD with FWF-funded project supervisor. Austrian PhD = employment contract = no financial stress. For MSc, plan self-funding or target Germany (DAAD) first and transfer.

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Very good for PhD (tax-advantaged); limited MSc

governmentScholarships.name: VLIR-UOS Scholarship (Flemish universities)
governmentScholarships.eligibility: Students from 31 development countries including Bangladesh
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Medium — Bangladesh is explicitly listed as partner country; ~50 scholarships/year across all programs

governmentScholarships.name: Belgian Federal Science Policy (Belspo)
governmentScholarships.eligibility: PhD researchers in science and technology

universityFunding.availability: Excellent for PhD — unique tax status

typicalPackage.phd: EUR 2,100-2,500/month (gross) with exceptional tax treatment — PhD scholarships are often 100% tax-exempt in Belgium
typicalPackage.msc: VLIR-UOS is primary MSc funding; internal waivers rare

universityFunding.fundingNote: CRITICAL: Belgian PhD scholarships are legally classified as 'educational grants' — they are 100% exempt from income tax AND social security contributions in many cases. A EUR 2,100/month scholarship in Belgium ≈ EUR 2,900/month in Germany after taxes.

externalFellowships.name: Marie Curie Fellowship
externalFellowships.eligibility: Postdoc; any nationality; Belgian host institution

externalFellowships.name: ERC Starting Grant (for postdocs)
externalFellowships.eligibility: 2-7 years post-PhD; any nationality; EU host

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Very good — tax-free EUR 2,100 goes far in Belgium
fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: Permitted; as PhD employee/scholar, full work rights
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply for VLIR-UOS scholarship for MSc at KU Leuven (strongly recommended — BD is partner country). Then apply for KU Leuven or UGent PhD with FWO or IMEC funding. The VLIR-UOS application opens in September; prepare by July. BD nationals have specifically been awarded VLIR-UOS consistently.

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Limited — most government scholarships require previous NZ connection

governmentScholarships.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
governmentScholarships.amount: Full tuition + NZD 1,750/month living + insurance + airfare
governmentScholarships.eligibility: Citizens of developing countries in Pacific/Asia; Bangladesh historically included
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Low — NZ prioritizes Pacific Island nations; BD allocations very few (2-5/year total all fields)

universityFunding.availability: Limited — NZ universities are fee-dependent; PhD funding exists but is competitive

typicalPackage.phd: NZD 28,000-35,000/year (Doctoral Scholarship) + tuition waiver; roughly living-cost adequate only
typicalPackage.msc: Very rarely funded; merit scholarships typically NZD 5,000-15,000 partial tuition

universityFunding.fundingNote: NZ PhD stipends (NZD 28,000-35,000) cover living costs minimally in Auckland but are adequate in Wellington or Christchurch. International tuition waiver is typically included — this is important as international fees are NZD 35,000+/year.

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Barely adequate in Auckland; adequate in Wellington/Christchurch
fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: 20 hours/week permitted
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply for PhD with supervisor-specific funding at University of Auckland AI group or Waikato ML group. Manaaki NZ scholarship is worth applying for but success rate is very low for BD CS applicants. Self-funded MSc is expensive — target Australia instead if budget is a concern. Callaghan Innovation PhD Fellowship is excellent if you can secure an NZ industry partner.

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Excellent — one of the world's most generous PhD funding systems

governmentScholarships.name: SINGA (Singapore International Graduate Award)
governmentScholarships.amount: SGD 2,200/month + tuition waiver + airfare (SGD 1,500) + settling-in allowance
governmentScholarships.eligibility: International students for PhD at NUS, NTU, SUTD, SIT, SUSS, A*STAR
governmentScholarships.competitiveness: High (1,000+ candidates for ~200 awards per round)
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Medium — BD applicants with strong CGPA (3.7+) and publications have been successful; engineering/CS fields prioritized

governmentScholarships.name: NUS Research Scholarship
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Medium — NUS admission is the bottleneck

universityFunding.availability: Excellent — nearly all admitted PhD students are funded

typicalPackage.phd: SGD 2,200-2,700/month + tuition waiver (total value SGD 150,000+ over 4yr)
typicalPackage.msc: Mostly self-funded; some competitive scholarships exist; focus on PhD route

fundingSources: A*STAR (Agency for Science, Technology and Research) project grants
topFundedUniversities: NUS (National University of Singapore — top 20 globally)
SUTD (Singapore University of Technology and Design — MIT partnership)
universityFunding.fundingNote: CRITICAL: Singapore's PhD funding is among the best in Asia. SGD 2,200/month is genuinely comfortable in Singapore if living outside CBD. NUS/NTU ranking (top 20 globally) means your PhD credential is world-class. SINGA bond: 3-year work commitment in Singapore after PhD — not a penalty but a career opportunity.

externalFellowships.name: A*STAR PhD Fellowship
externalFellowships.eligibility: Outstanding international students; research at A*STAR institutes (IMCB, IISG)

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Adequate — SGD 2,200 covers rent (SGD 800-1,200 shared, SGD 1,500-2,000 studio) and food comfortably

selfFundingCost.phdTotal: Fully funded if SINGA/NUS scholarship awarded

fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: 16 hours/week for PhD students; full-time during vacation
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply to SINGA in BOTH rounds (January and June). Simultaneously apply to NUS and NTU directly. If you have one publication and CGPA 3.7+, your chances are genuine. SINGA bond means 3 years in Singapore post-PhD — with Singapore's COMPASS and Golden Pass, this gives you a strong PR application. Target AI/ML and computer vision labs at NUS SoC (School of Computing) — Tat-Seng Chua and Harold Soh labs are world-class.

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Good for PhD; moderate for MSc via Eiffel

governmentScholarships.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
governmentScholarships.amount: EUR 1,181/month (MSc) or EUR 1,400/month (PhD) + health insurance + cultural activities
governmentScholarships.eligibility: International students under 30 (MSc) or 35 (PhD); nominated by French institution
governmentScholarships.competitiveness: Very High (500 awarded from 10,000+ applications globally)
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Low-Medium — BD applicants in engineering admitted historically; requires institutional nomination first

governmentScholarships.name: French Government Scholarship (BGF)
governmentScholarships.eligibility: Master's or PhD; bilateral agreement countries; via Campus France BD
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Medium — Campus France Dhaka actively promotes; 20-30 scholarships/year for BD nationals across all fields

universityFunding.availability: Good for PhD — contrat doctoral system

typicalPackage.phd: EUR 2,100/month (contrat doctoral — full employment contract, 3 years, renewable) + health insurance + pension
typicalPackage.msc: Eiffel or BGF scholarship main routes; occasional excellence stipends at Ecole Polytechnique (EUR 1,000/month)

fundingSources: ANR (Agence Nationale de la Recherche) projects
universityFunding.fundingNote: French contrat doctoral is the most employee-friendly PhD contract in Europe — full social security, healthcare, 25 days vacation, right to strike. EUR 2,100/month after employer charges. CIFRE (industry PhD) pays EUR 2,500+ as you work with a company simultaneously — excellent for AI engineers.

externalFellowships.name: Campus France Scholarship (BD-France)
externalFellowships.eligibility: BD nationals admitted to French program; via Campus France Dhaka (House 8, Rd 53, Gulshan)

externalFellowships.name: Marie Curie MSCA Doctoral Fellowship
externalFellowships.eligibility: Early career researcher; French host institution; any nationality

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Adequate outside Paris; tight in Paris (EUR 2,100 minus EUR 1,200 rent = EUR 900 remaining)

selfFundingCost.mscTotal: EUR 12,000-20,000 (low tuition + living costs; most affordable EU option for MSc)

fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: 60 hours/month maximum as PhD contractor; MSc students up to 964 hours/year
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Step 1: Contact Campus France Dhaka (Gulshan) — they are the gateway to French scholarships and have a dedicated office. Step 2: Apply to BGF scholarship (March) simultaneously with university applications. Step 3: For PhD, write to INRIA or Ecole Polytechnique professors directly about ANR-funded PhD positions — many are advertised in English. CIFRE is the elite path: get a French company (Thales, Airbus, Mistral AI) to co-fund your PhD.

fundingOpportunities.fundingAvailability: Exceptional — MBZUAI is one of the world's most generous AI scholarships globally

governmentScholarships.name: MBZUAI Full Scholarship (MSc)
governmentScholarships.amount: Full tuition (AED 100,000+) + AED 9,300/month living stipend + health insurance + furnished housing + return airfare
governmentScholarships.eligibility: BSc in CS/AI/Math/Engineering; IELTS 6.5+; CGPA 3.5+ recommended; no GRE required
governmentScholarships.competitiveness: High but not extreme — 500-700 MSc applicants for ~100-150 seats; BD acceptance rate medium-high given strong CS reputation
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Good — BUET, AUST, IUT, Dhaka University graduates have been admitted; publication helps but not required

governmentScholarships.name: MBZUAI Full Scholarship (PhD)
governmentScholarships.amount: Full tuition + AED 11,000/month + housing + health + airfare
governmentScholarships.eligibility: MSc degree in relevant field; research proposal; strong academic record
governmentScholarships.bangladeshiSuccess: Medium — requires prior MSc from strong institution or MBZUAI MSc itself

universityFunding.availability: Exceptional — MBZUAI funds ALL admitted students as a policy

typicalPackage.phd: AED 11,000/month + tuition waiver + furnished housing; approximately USD 3,000/month take-home
typicalPackage.msc: AED 9,300/month + tuition waiver + furnished housing; approximately USD 2,530/month take-home

fundingSources: UAE Government (Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge)
topFundedUniversities: MBZUAI (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence)
universityFunding.fundingNote: MBZUAI is the world's first fully AI-focused university and ALL students are fully funded. This is NOT a scholarship you apply for separately — admission = full funding. Tax-free stipend of AED 9,300/month = approximately USD 2,530/month with zero deductions. Furnished housing is provided or housing allowance given. Effectively, you receive USD 30,000+ per year while studying in a world-class AI program.

externalFellowships.name: G42 PhD Fellowship
externalFellowships.amount: AED 15,000/month + research budget + NVIDIA GPU cluster access
externalFellowships.eligibility: PhD candidates working on G42-relevant research (LLMs, genomics AI, smart cities)

externalFellowships.name: Technology Innovation Institute (TII) Fellowship
externalFellowships.eligibility: Postdoctoral researchers in AI, quantum, autonomous systems

fundingOpportunities.livingStipendAdequacy: Very good — AED 9,300/month in Abu Dhabi allows comfortable living with savings

selfFundingCost.mscTotal: N/A — all admitted students are funded
selfFundingCost.phdTotal: N/A — all admitted students are funded

fundingOpportunities.workWhileStudying: On-campus research and TA roles encouraged; off-campus requires additional permit
fundingOpportunities.realisticStrategy: Apply to MBZUAI as your TOP PRIORITY. This is the single best scholarship available to Bangladeshi CS/AI graduates globally in terms of funding generosity and admission competitiveness ratio. PREPARATION: (1) IELTS 7.0 target, (2) Contact MBZUAI faculty whose research matches your interest (email in English, reference their specific papers), (3) Two recommendation letters — one from your university professor, one from an industry supervisor if possible. Apply in the February round for September intake. If rejected, apply in the May round for January intake.

bestPhdFunding: USA top programs (88% chance, high stipend)
summaryComparison.strategicAdvice: PhD almost always funded at top programs - apply directly. MSc requires strategy: target Germany/Norway for low tuition, or China/Japan/Korea for government scholarships, or self-fund in expensive countries only if wealthy or planning high-salary jobs to recoup costs quickly.
